caption: The drawing depicts a section of a wrought iron fence composed of vertical bars and decorative scrollwork. There are five main vertical posts: the leftmost post features a spearhead-shaped top and a circular scroll design curving outward and upward, with another scroll motif returning inward. The next three vertical posts each terminate in diamond-shaped spear points, with two of these posts featuring large, symmetrical, heart-like scroll patterns that curve inward and nearly meet at the center of the post. The final vertical post on the right also has a spearhead-shaped top and a scroll design similar in style to the others. A diagonal support bar runs from near the base to the top left corner, connecting with the upright post. All metalwork is rendered in shades of gray with hints of brown and subtle white highlights, suggesting reflections, while the background is a plain beige color, with the lower portion showing some indications of grass. The composition fills most of the vertical space of the drawing, and the lines are mainly clean and precise, emphasizing the structure and decorative details of the fence.
title: Wrought Iron Fence
